description: You can accept a job partly because of a manager and have a different one within a year. Nothing you agreed to has changed.

aspect: The exit is the only real lever
description: Internal processes for a bad-but-lawful manager are weak everywhere. The options are endure, transfer or leave.
energy_note: Three options, two of which cost you the job.

description: He leaves after eighteen months. The manager he left is the reference the next employer will call. He lists a colleague instead and hopes nobody asks why.
